source_caption_text:
Reggie has reportedly dropped a video explaining why he feels left out and why he’s choosing to distance himself from the group. According to Reggie, the situation goes deeper than just being excluded — he says he feels like the friendships and loyalty within the group aren’t what they used to be.

One of his biggest claims is directed at Ray, who Reggie says is more focused on money than genuine friendships. He suggests that when it comes down to it, Ray’s priorities aren’t necessarily about maintaining real relationships or looking out for the people around him, but rather about what benefits him financially. 💰

Reggie also has words for Rakai, claiming that Rakai is more concerned with creating a viral moment and getting attention online than actually addressing the issues within the group. According to Reggie, the pursuit of views, clips and social-media moments has become more important than the friendships themselves. 

Now, Reggie says he’s officially leaving the Cloverboys, making it clear that he feels there’s no reason to continue being part of a group where he believes he isn’t valued or included.
